reuse.why: Extends the existing getMonthActionCategories query, but ignores the notes table (written by server/notes) where group notes actually live and the shared tag helpers, inventing a category_groups.notes column and its own SQL regex.

duplication.why: The #fixed rule is written once, in a single SQL clause; the only overlap is a hand-rolled tag regex parallel to shared/tags.ts.

placement.why: Introduces a schema migration and DbCategoryGroup field for data that the tree stores in the notes table keyed by group id, so the rule reads a column nothing writes.

scope.why: Adds an unnecessary migration and type change on top of the one-line rule and its test.

maintainability.why: A parallel, never-populated notes column on category_groups would confuse maintainers and diverge from the app's real group notes; copyPreviousMonth still ignores the rule.

bypasses_abstraction.where: migrations/..._add_category_group_notes.sql and getMonthActionCategories read g.notes instead of the notes table/notes app that stores group notes; copyPreviousMonth keeps its own filter and never applies #fixed.

one_place.where: The rule lands in getMonthActionCategories, but copyPreviousMonth in budget/actions.ts filters getBudgetData rows on its own and does not apply it.
